description: Address semantic review issues: update_event_field allowlist, deep-link maxsplit, create_ticket session safety, deploy backup path, get_all_clubs eager loading, and migration for new Event columns.
steps: STEP 1 - Add allowlist to update_event_field in crud.py
STEP 2 - Fix deep-link hash parsing with maxsplit in scanner.py
STEP 3 - Fix create_ticket retry loop by saving user data before the loop
STEP 4 - Change deploy_bot.sh backup path from /tmp to persistent directory
STEP 5 - Add selectinload(Club.users) to get_all_clubs in crud.py
STEP 6 - Add migration check in init_db for new Event columns
acceptance_criteria: update_event_field rejects field names not in the allowlist
Deep-link split uses maxsplit=3 to preserve underscores in hash
create_ticket saves user data before retry loop for ticket image generation
get_all_clubs uses selectinload(Club.users) to eagerly load users
init_db checks for and adds missing event_date, location, check_in_enabled columns
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/bott/UFQ_EVENT_BOT_FINAL && python -m py_compile bot/database/crud.py && echo OK
Run: python -m py_compile bot/handlers/scanner.py && echo OK
Run: python -m py_compile bot/database/db.py && echo OK
Run: grep -q 'ALLOWED_FIELDS' bot/database/crud.py && echo PASS || echo FAIL
Run: grep -q 'maxsplit' bot/handlers/scanner.py && echo PASS || echo FAIL
Run: grep -q '/home/ubuntu/ufq_db_backup' deploy_bot.sh && echo PASS || echo FAIL
Run: grep -q 'selectinload' bot/database/crud.py && echo PASS || echo FAIL
findings: All 6 fixes implemented and verified via py_compile and import checks. The allowlist uses a set for O(1) lookup. The migration function checks PRAGMA table_info before running ALTER TABLE statements. The create_ticket function now saves all user/event data to local variables before the retry loop.
